summary: Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian infrastructure targets in Kyiv and across multiple regions, while Ukrainian forces launched reactive drone attacks against Russian logistics and civilian infrastructure. Putin stated Russia is prepared to resume peace negotiations after elections but criticized Ukrainian attacks on Moscow. NATO members agreed on financial support for Ukraine amid ongoing economic pressures.
key_points: Russian forces claimed to destroy a data center 'Datagroup' in Kyiv that processed Ukrainian intelligence data (Source: @tass_agency/397357).
Ukrainian reactive drones targeted a logistics center of company 'Heavy Logistics Ukraine' in Kyiv region (Source: @tass_agency/397355).
Russian air defenses reportedly shot down 55 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea in one day (Source: @tass_agency/397391).
Ukrainian forces reported hitting two Russian oil refineries and radio engineering stations in Perm region and Novoshakhtinsk (Source: @UkraineNow/84294).
Putin stated Russia is ready to resume peace negotiations with Ukraine after elections but criticized attacks on Moscow (Source: @tass_agency/397389).
NATO members agreed on €6.6 billion in financial support for Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84296).
Ukrainian reactive drones launched from various directions toward Kyiv, Chernihiv, and other regions (Source: @kpszsu/80136).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces claimed destruction of Ukrainian intelligence data centers in Kyiv while Ukrainian forces launched coordinated reactive drone strikes across multiple regions. Putin announced Russia's readiness to resume peace negotiations after elections but condemned Ukrainian attacks on Moscow. NATO members finalized €6.6 billion in financial support for Ukraine amid ongoing economic pressures from the conflict.

points: Ukrainian forces reported striking two Russian oil refineries - Lukoil Permnefteorgsintez in Perm region and Novoshakhtinsk NPZ in Rostov region, causing fires on both facilities that were supplying fuel to the Russian military (Source: @UkraineNow/84294).
Ukrainian forces also destroyed Russian radio engineering stations 'Gamma-S1' and 'Kasta-2E2' near Novoshakhtinsk (Source: @UkraineNow/84294).
Proactive drone attacks targeted Russian logistics infrastructure including the 'Heavy Logistics Ukraine' company center in Kyiv region (Source: @tass_agency/397355).
Ukrainian forces destroyed a data center 'Datagroup' in Kyiv that was processing and transmitting intelligence data for the Ukrainian armed forces (Source: @tass_agency/397357).
NATO members agreed on €6.6 billion in financial support for Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84296).
Zelensky requested Trump to influence Putin to end the war and announced upcoming US-Ukraine-Russia talks within 10 days (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33512).

Putin stated economic relations with the United States are nearly zero (Source: @tass_agency/397384).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are demonstrating capability to strike Ukrainian intelligence and critical infrastructure targets deep within Ukraine, including data centers and logistics facilities. Ukrainian forces are conducting coordinated drone strikes across multiple regions, targeting Russian fuel infrastructure and military logistics. The conflict is expanding beyond traditional front lines with both sides attacking civilian infrastructure. Economic warfare is intensifying with strikes on energy infrastructure and supply chains. Both sides are leveraging asymmetric warfare capabilities including commercial drones and cruise missiles.
sections.regional_response: NATO members have agreed on €6.6 billion in financial support for Ukraine, demonstrating continued alliance commitment despite economic pressures. European leaders are increasingly concerned about the conflict spreading beyond Ukraine's borders. The Slovakian prime minister expressed concerns about potential military escalation involving NATO territories. China's role in providing drone technology to Russia has raised concerns about technology transfer and conflict escalation. The United States is preparing for potential military operations in Cuba according to internal Pentagon documents (Source: @tass_agency/397355).
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian forces are effectively using commercial drone technology for both offensive and defensive operations across multiple operational domains. Russian forces claim successful targeting of Ukrainian intelligence capabilities, suggesting improved electronic warfare capabilities. The coordination of drone strikes across wide geographic areas indicates sophisticated command and control systems. Both sides are increasingly targeting economic infrastructure, indicating a shift toward economic warfare. Reports of delayed air raid warnings in Kyiv suggest potential vulnerabilities in civilian defense systems (Source: @eRadarrua/116864).
